score.intro: Earn free insurance score every block by holding USD8 or sUSD8.
score.totalHelp: Your total insurance score earned across all holdings. Score updates may be delayed by around 13–19 minutes while Ethereum blocks finalize.

asset.coverageHelp: Coverage is subject to the amount available in the cover pools.
asset.scoreRateHelp: You get {rate} score per day for every {unit} you hold. Rewarded every block.

susd8.title: sUSD8 Savings USD8 (Morpho)
susd8.apyHelp: Paid in USD8 from USD8's treasury yield: the USDC backing USD8 earns DeFi yield, and part of it goes to the sUSD8 vault.

claims.title: File Insurance Claims
claims.intro: Use your insurance score to file a claim if an insured token drops more than 20% against its underlying asset.
claims.availableHelp: Score becomes available to use after {duration}, minus any score already spent on claims.

coverPools.title: Cover Pools
coverPools.help: Deposit a pool's token (e.g. wstETH) to earn yield in USD8, paid from USD8's treasury yield. In return, the pool backs insured tokens: if one drops more than 20% and an incident opens, pool assets pay valid claims, up to a capped share of the pool per incident. Withdrawals have a 7-day cooldown, and assets waiting to withdraw still cover claims.
coverPools.warning: Deposit into a Cover Pool to back insured tokens and earn yield. APYs can be high, but be aware: if an insured token suffers a loss, pool deposits may be used to pay claims. Make sure you understand the <link>risks involved</link>.

whiteHat.title: White Hat Economy
whiteHat.message: The White Hat Economy will launch once USD8 holds a meaningful amount of insured tokens acquired through the claim process. <link>Learn More</link>.

pool.apyHelpSource: Paid in USD8 from USD8's treasury yield: the USDC backing all USD8 earns DeFi yield, and part of it goes to cover pools.
pool.apyHelpWhyHigh: It can be high because pools are kept small compared with USD8's supply, so that yield is shared by far fewer deposits.
pool.filledHelpUncapped: This pool has no deposit cap.
pool.filledHelp: How full this pool is against its deposit cap. At 100% it stops accepting deposits until someone withdraws.
pool.earningsHelp: Earnings are paid in USD8, not {asset}. Earnings are not exposed to insurance claims and can be withdrawn at any time.
